titulo: Your TV remote is shining a light at you 📺 #howitworks #shorts
descripcion:
Every button press is a burst of invisible light, flashing 38,000 times a second. Your phone camera can see it.

What should we explain next?

#howitworks #engineering #tvremote #infrared #shorts

lineas.texto: Your TV remote shines a light at your TV. You just can't see it.
Point a phone camera at it and press a button. There it is.
Inside, every button sits on a little rubber dome.
Press it, and a carbon pad under the dome touches the board and closes a circuit.
A tiny chip knows which button it was, and turns it into a code.
Then an infrared LED flashes that code, in short bursts of light.
Each burst blinks thirty-eight thousand times per second. Long gap, short gap: ones and zeros.
A sensor on the TV ignores every light that doesn't blink at that exact speed, and reads the code.
Volume up. Now you know. What should we explain next?
